title: A ball drops into a basket (Physics-IQ)
caption: In the real video the ball drops through the opening and stays in the basket. The untrained Wan2.2 bounces the ball back out and rolls it off screen; MoPlan drops it into the basket, where it stays, as in the real video.
benchmark_detail: scenario 0014 (ball-in-basket, center view), best-practice description prompt

first_frame.faithful: byte-identical copy of the generation input
first_frame.source: Physics-IQ switch frame switch-frames/0014_switch-frames_anyFPS_perspective-center_trimmed-ball-in-basket.jpg, as used by the Physics-IQ Verified evaluation; byte-identical (same sha256) to the file of the same name in the original public Physics-IQ release, gs://physics-iq-benchmark/switch-frames/
first_frame.attribution: Physics-IQ, Copyright 2024 DeepMind Technologies Limited, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); unmodified

protocol.name: physics_iq
protocol.image: the 3840x2160 Physics-IQ switch frame (the original public release file, also used by Physics-IQ Verified), RGB, resized to 448x256 with LANCZOS

sampler.scheduler: UniPCMultistepScheduler of the Wan2.2 pipeline (flow shift 3.0)
sampler.guidance_note: the same scale is used for the high-noise and the low-noise expert

protocol.output: 41 frames written with imageio (libx264, quality 8) at 8 fps (raw), then trimmed to the first 5 s with ffmpeg -t 5 (trimmed); the composite shows the trimmed clip

seed_rule: seed = 42 for every Physics-IQ video (run 1); both models use the same seed; the noise comes from torch.Generator('cuda').manual_seed(seed)

panels.label: Real video

source.public_release_check: sha256 identical to the file in the original public Physics-IQ release

panels.display: the recorded continuation from the switch frame (3.0 s), resampled to 8 fps and scaled to 448x256

panels.label: Wan2.2 (untrained, same seed)
panels.model: untrained Wan2.2-I2V-A14B (Diffusers weights in $WAN_MODEL_DIR), same pipeline without LoRA, adapter or motion condition
panels.prompt: Static locked-off single-shot with fixed frame throughout filmed with constant framerate in real-time. The scene shows a realistic scientific demonstration. The scene only contains the described setup and actions. The black plastic crate sits on a wooden table. The orange inflatable basketball is released over the black plastic crate.
panels.command: python generate.py --protocol physics_iq --image assets/showcase/06_piq_ball_in_basket/first_frame.jpg --prompt 'Static locked-off single-shot with fixed frame throughout filmed with constant framerate in real-time. The scene shows a realistic scientific demonstration. The scene only contains the described setup and actions. The black plastic crate sits on a wooden table. The orange inflatable basketball is released over the black plastic crate.' --seed 42 --base --out out/showcase/06_piq_ball_in_basket/base.mp4

reference.kind: raw = 41-frame mp4 before trimming, trimmed = 40-frame mp4 (first 5 s)

panels.label: MoPlan (ours)
panels.model: MoPlan final model: Stage-1 motion predictor ($MOPLAN_WEIGHTS/stage1) and the Stage-2 generator (LoRA and motion adapter on both Wan2.2 experts, $MOPLAN_WEIGHTS/stage2/{high,low})
panels.prompt: Static locked-off single-shot with fixed frame throughout filmed with constant framerate in real-time. The scene shows a realistic scientific demonstration. reference.kind: raw = 41-frame mp4 before trimming, trimmed = 40-frame mp4 (first 5 s)

panels.masks_note: --masks gives the reference run's k16 masks; the released mask builder keeps different instances on Physics-IQ frames, so without it the MoPlan panel is not expected to match

composite.encoding: panels stacked side by side (rows stacked vertically), labels burned in, libx264 crf 24, yuv420p
composite.inputs: the generated panels are the trimmed reference mp4 files; the real panel is the source video
composite.reproducibility: the composite is a re-encode with burned-in labels and is not byte-reproducible; compare regenerated panels with the per-panel references instead

masks.content: k16 SAM 2.1 instance masks of the first frame from the reference run (instance_masks [16,160,160] and instance_channels [2,160,160], fp16; source sam2.1_hiera_large_automatic+filter_v2), read by the MoPlan command with --masks
